admission.title: GA and EFW — decides where she delivers

items.t: 24⁺⁰–25⁺⁶: allow labour; comfort-care evaluation at birth; PPROM → discuss specialist
26⁺⁰–31⁺⁶ or EFW < 1.5 kg: BMZ dose 1 (+ nifedipine if contracting) → REFER
32⁺⁰–33⁺⁶ and EFW ≥ 1.5 kg: treat at ANDH
≥ 34 wk or EFW ≥ 2 kg: term labour pathway

admission.title: Red flags to rule out on arrival

decision.t: 10. Diagnosis = PRETERM LABOUR / PPROM 26⁺⁰–31⁺⁶ wk or EFW < 1.5 kg → BMZ dose 1, nifedipine if contracting, antibiotics if ROM, then REFER. Chorioamnionitis or other §2 → do not suppress; deliver, or REFER if < 32 wk · 24⁺⁰–25⁺⁶ wk → allow labour, discuss with specialist hospital

11. 32⁺⁰–33⁺⁶ wk and EFW ≥ 1.5 kg, no §2 → ADMIT (≥ 34 wk → term labour pathway) — stabilise, then continue on the preterm labour management chart and the 24-hour preterm nursing record. If labour proceeds, use the term labour nursing record.

chart.phase_note: Clock starts at first nifedipine / BMZ dose. < 32 wk or EFW < 1.5 kg: rows apply until transfer. ANDH: nifedipine, steroids, MgSO₄, KMC ≥ 1.2 kg (†), Neopuff; no CS, induction, CPAP or NICU → REFER.
